name: percentile-chart
title: PercentileChart
description: p50/p95/p99 over time as shaded bands (not three flat lines) in pure SVG. The p50–p95 and p95–p99 spans render as filled areas + a p50 reference line, so the spread reads at a glance. Honest empty state; sr-only table for a11y parity. Reuses linScale/niceMax/seriesPath from TrendChart.
